<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_cmdbgov_app.CMDBGovAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description>Client-callable endpoint used by the CMDB Governance dashboard.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>CMDBGovAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/**
 * CMDBGovAjax
 * Client-callable endpoint used by the CMDB Governance dashboard (UI page).
 * Returns JSON strings: { ok: true, data: ... } or { ok: false, error: "..." }.
 *
 * Requires role x_cmdbgov_app.viewer (x_cmdbgov_app.admin contains it).
 *
 * Scope: x_cmdbgov_app   Client callable: true
 */
var CMDBGovAjax = Class.create();

CMDBGovAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    /** Full scorecard: all pillars, per-class breakdown, top issues. */
    getScorecard: function() {
        return this._respond(function() {
            return new CMDBGovEngine().scorecard();
        });
    },

    /** Records failing one check for one class. */
    getRecords: function() {
        var checkId = String(this.getParameter('sysparm_check') || '');
        var table = String(this.getParameter('sysparm_table') || '');
        var arg = String(this.getParameter('sysparm_arg') || '');
        return this._respond(function() {
            return new CMDBGovEngine().records(checkId, table, arg || undefined);
        });
    },

    /** Lightweight connection test for the Settings tab. */
    testConnection: function() {
        return this._respond(function() {
            var cfg = new CMDBGovConfig().get();
            var ds = new CMDBGovDataSource(cfg);
            var started = new Date().getTime();
            var n = ds.count('cmdb_ci', '');
            return {
                source: ds.describe(),
                cmdbCiCount: n,
                ms: new Date().getTime() - started
            };
        });
    },

    _respond: function(fn) {
        if (!gs.hasRole('x_cmdbgov_app.viewer'))
            return JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'You need the x_cmdbgov_app.viewer role to use CMDB Governance.' });
        try {
            return JSON.stringify({ ok: true, data: fn() });
        } catch (e) {
            var m = (e && e.message) ? e.message : String(e);
            gs.error('[CMDB Governance] ' + m);
            return JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: m });
        }
    },

    type: 'CMDBGovAjax'
});
</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-18 04:54:05</sys_created_on><sys_id>09057d4ca0e556b5b4e48d87319e05e9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-18 04:54:05</sys_updated_on><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_09057d4ca0e556b5b4e48d87319e05e9</sys_update_name><sys_package display_value="CMDB Governance" source="x_cmdbgov_app">1a9f4ea4623358e6ab416ae78953397e</sys_package><sys_scope display_value="CMDB Governance">1a9f4ea4623358e6ab416ae78953397e</sys_scope></sys_script_include></record_update>
